newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs down sharply on cash concerns, sell stops.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs down sharply on cash concerns, sell stops.

text.p: CME hog futures turned sharply lower as selling increased and touched off sell stops on concern over cash hog markets next week, traders said.
Cash hog calls for Monday turned mostly lower after firm ideas early, prompting long liquidation by midsession.
Cash pork products are not as strong as expected and packers will likely reduce bids on Monday for hogs, traders said.
December paced the break on added bear spreading and tumbled 1.500 cents before finding support.
Hogs are currently down 1.100 to 0.200 cent a lb with October off 0.825 at 72.200 cents.
Rand Financials and Rosenthal Collins were notable sellers, they added.
